evidence: ZTB exposure followed by H2O exposure was cyclically repeated 2–15 times at various substrate temperatures (Tsub). The exposure time for ZTB was 10–180 s and 60 s for H2O. The vapor pressure of ZTB during deposition was controlled to 0.01–0.04 kPa and H2O pressure was controlled to 0.13–1.05 kPa. Tsub was between 75–400 °C.
